text:
hana: Hi all  just unboxed my MacBook Air (M2) and hit a snag during setup. MDM profile installed but the Company Portal app can't download ("Download failed: cannot verify server certificate") and Slack SSO errors out. Anyone encountered this in onboarding?

it-support: Welcome @hana! Quick checks: are you on redwood-secure or a hotspot? Also paste the serial if you can.

hana: On redwood-secure. Serial: C02HANA12345. Screenshot says 'cannot verify server certificate (certificate chain incomplete)'. I did try my phone hotspot and Company Portal downloads fine there but SSO still fails with 'device not trusted'.

it-support: Interesting. Hotspot working for the portal suggests corp Wi-Fi or proxy modifying TLS. For the SSO device trust, did you accept the Okta Device Trust profile and allow the system extension in Privacy & Security? That often sets user-affinity.

hana: I installed the Okta profile but the Privacy & Security pane shows the blocked system software message and no Allow button appears. Also I don't have admin to run any diagnostic commands.

emily: @hana we can grant temporary admin for troubleshooting. Want me to enable for 2 hours?

hana: Yes please, that'd be great.

emily: Granted 2h temporary admin for @hana.

hana: Thanks. Ran `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and got: "Enrollment request failed: TLS handshake failed: certificate verify failed (unable to get local issuer certificate)".

it-support: That confirms a cert chain problem from our LB to the MDM backend. @marco can you check the ingress cert chain and the corp proxy rules?

marco: Checking the ingress chain now  saw one node missing intermediate earlier which we patched but the proxy cache might still present the old chain to internal clients. Pushing a cache flush to the proxy cluster for the onboarding backend.

it-support: After Marco's flush, reboot and try `profiles renew` again. If it still fails, try a wired connection (USB-C -> ethernet) to bypass Wi-Fi proxies.

hana: Rebooted and retried; `profiles renew` now shows success and last check-in updated. Company Portal download still fails on corp Wi-Fi though (works on hotspot).

it-support: If portal downloads over HTTPS but shows server cert as proxy, we can push the proxy CA to the device via MDM so the device trusts it for internal hosts. However for onboarding we prefer no TLS interception. @security any objections to pushing the proxy CA to onboarding group temporarily?

security: For short-term onboarding it's fine but log the change. We should push only the subordinate CA for redwood-proxy and remove it after onboarding window. Marco, add a removal job.

marco: Pushed proxy CA to onboarding group. @hana please reboot and try Company Portal again.

hana: Portal download succeeded after reboot. Okta now says "device not trusted" though. Okta logs show "attestation missing: no key registered".

it-support: That usually means the Okta agent didn't complete a device key registration. Reinstall the Okta Device Trust profile while you're signed into Okta in Safari (not Chrome) so user-affinity is captured. Then immediately open System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> General to click Allow for Okta. The Allow banner is time-sensitive.

hana: Did that, clicked Allow, rebooted. Post-reboot Okta still shows 'device not trusted'. The Okta logs now show "attestation callback 403: missing client cert".

it-support: That 403 indicates our attestation relay failed to present the client cert to Okta. @marco can you check the relay TLS config?

marco: Found the problem: the relay's client cert rotation completed but the new cert wasn't uploaded to the Okta integration. Rolling the old cert back for now and re-uploading the new cert properly. Give it a minute and then try re-enrolling the agent.

hana: After a minute Okta updated to 'Device Trusted'. Thanks! Two quick follow-ups: 1) FileVault didn't prompt during setup, should I enable now? 2) The macOS update to 14.x isn't offered even though I'm on 13.6.

it-support: Enable FileVault and let it encrypt; we'll check escrow after. For macOS 14, we block major upgrades for new employees until our images are validated; that's expected.

hana: Enabled FileVault, encryption kicked off. Ran `fdesetup status` and it says "FileVault is On".

macbot: [automated] FileVault personal recovery key escrowed to KMS for device C02HANA12345.

hana: Confirmed, thanks. Final note: while installing Homebrew I ran into permission errors until I used `/opt/homebrew` on ARM. No admin needed afterwards, and Docker desktop needs extra approval for virtualization.

it-support: Good notes  we'll add a line to the new-hire doc: "Use hotspot to isolate enroll issues; grant temporary admin if system extension Allow not visible; enable FileVault manually if not prompted; macOS major upgrades blocked initially."

security: Also logging the proxy CA temporary push and adding a runbook entry for attestation relay cert rotation.

hana: Appreciate the help and the warm welcome! :smile:

emily: Welcome to Redwood @hana! Ping #new-hires for anything else.
